title: EnchatmentsСoolTNT
description: A Datapack that adds 8 new enchantments to the Turtle Helmet, Trident, and other items.
body:
# The DataPack adds 8 new enchantment:

## 2 enchantment for the turtle shell :

Turtle protection: increases protection, but reduces movement speed, and has 4 levels of enchantment

1 level: +2 protection, -10% movement speed

2 level: +3 protection, -15% movement speed

3 level: +4 protection, -20% movement speed

4 level: +5 protection, -25% movement speed

Incompatible enchantments: protection, blast protection, fire protection

![Turtle protection](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ab54a51c458040c50a02dbe8ad8e983c18385b6.png)

Dolphin speed: increases movement speed in water, and has 3 levels of enchantment 

1 level: +1.5 movement speed in water

2 level: +2 movement speed in water

3 level: +2.5 movement speed in water

Incompatible enchantments: respiration, aqua affinity

![Dolphin speed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6614f33a8a40a30da75fbfe7b65b7f7769e4ede0.png)

## 2 enchantment for the trident:

Toxic: there is a chance to apply the poison effect when attacking an entity, and has 5 levels of enchantment

1 level: 5% the chance of applying an effect, 1.5-6.5 sec. duration of effect, 1-3 effect level

2 level: 10% the chance of applying an effect, 2-7 sec. duration of effect, 1-3 effect level

3 level: 15% the chance of applying an effect, 2.5-7.5 sec. duration of effect, 2-4 effect level

4 level: 20% the chance of applying an effect, 3-8 sec. duration of effect, 2-4 effect level

5 level: 25% the chance of applying an effect, 3.5-8.5 sec. duration of effect, 3-5effect level

Incompatible enchantments: impaling, levitation

![Toxic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c31885402c66ce97fe047f4664d87a08aa29426b.png)

Levitation: there is a chance to apply the levitation effect when attacking an entity, and has 5 levels of enchantment

1 level: 5% the chance of applying an effect, 3-5 sec. duration of effect, 1-2 effect level

2 level: 10% the chance of applying an effect, 3.5-5.5 sec. duration of effect, 1-2 effect level

3 level: 15% the chance of applying an effect, 4-6 sec. duration of effect, 2-3 effect level

4 level: 20% the chance of applying an effect, 4.5-6.5 sec. duration of effect, 2-3 effect level

5 level: 25% the chance of applying an effect, 5-7 sec.duration of effect, 3-4 effect level

Incompatible enchantments: impaling, toxic

![Levitation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bcf6e82360234488b6eb7da9211b00fc645860be.png)

## 1 enchantment for the chestplate:

Fire thorns: with each attack you receive, the attacker will burn out, and has 3 levels of enchantment

1 level: the attacker is on fire 2.5 sec.

2 level: the attacker is on fire 5 sec.

3 level: the attacker is on fire 7.5 sec.

Incompatible enchantments: thorns

![Fire_thorns](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/198e4640d10986a30ad56fcf3f4f95e8434571dd.png)

## 1 enchantment for the sworld:

Poison: there is a chance to apply the poison effect when attacking an entity, and has 2 levels of enchantment

1 level: 5%  the chance of applying an effect, 2.5-5 sec. duration of effect, 1-2 effect level

2 level: 10%  the chance of applying an effect, 3.5-5.5 sec. duration of effect, 2-3 effect level

Incompatible enchantments: fire aspect

![Poison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3ee3378a7827af65c6c56f74cad1f60e5618c3d.png)

## 1 enchantment for the mace:

Wind rush: after each attack, it spawns a wind charge under you, and has 1 levels of enchantment

Incompatible enchantments: wind burst

![Wind_rush](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6bf22e8124055669451d7f328a832b68e6308146.png)

## 1  enchantment for the bow:

Bow shot: shoots 3 arrows instead of 1

![Bow_shot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c993ef38d77a0ed9d1fe635449c88289892773c.png)

## Additional information:
All enchantments can be obtained at the enchantment table, some of them can be obtained at the maximum level, and some cannot. These enchantments can also be obtained from books, which increases the chances of obtaining the desired enchantments.

When entering the world, an error may occur, which is a bug that cannot be fixed in 1.21 and 1.21.1. However, it is safe to click on the button: "I know what I'm doing!"

![world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95a1beb77199153f8f86257d34706df6549afc59_0.webp)

If you find any errors in the DataPack, feel free to report them on Discord (preferably in Russian), thank you for downloading my creation!
